# thalassa_containerregistry_namespace_configuration (Resource)

Manage configuration for a container registry namespace in Thalassa Cloud

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "thalassa_containerregistry_namespace" "example" {
  region    = "nl-01"
  namespace = "example"
}

resource "thalassa_containerregistry_namespace_configuration" "example" {
  namespace_id = thalassa_containerregistry_namespace.example.id
  visibility   = "private"

  retention_policy {
    enabled                = true
    delete_untagged_images = true

    rules {
      days  = 30
      count = 10
      scope = "tags"
      tag_patterns = [
        "v*",
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `namespace_id` (String) Identity of the container registry namespace
- `visibility` (String) Visibility of the namespace (currently only private)

### Optional

- `organisation_id` (String) Organisation of the namespace. If not provided, the organisation of the (Terraform) provider will be used.
- `retention_policy` (Block List, Max: 1) Retention policy for the namespace (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--retention_policy))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC3339)
- `id` (String) Identity of the namespace this configuration belongs to
- `object_version` (Number) Object version of the configuration
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp (RFC3339)

<a id="nestedblock--retention_policy"></a>
### Nested Schema for `retention_policy`

Optional:

- `delete_untagged_images` (Boolean) Whether to delete untagged images
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the retention policy is active
- `rules` (Block List) List of retention rules (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--retention_policy--rules))

<a id="nestedblock--retention_policy--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `retention_policy.rules`

Optional:

- `count` (Number) Number of most recent versions/tags to keep
- `days` (Number) Retain tags based on tag creation age in days
- `days_since_created` (Number) Retain artifacts based on creation/push age in days
- `days_since_pulled` (Number) Retain artifacts based on last pull age in days
- `repository_patterns` (List of String) Repository name patterns this rule applies to
- `scope` (String) Scope of the retention rule (currently only tags)
- `tag_patterns` (List of String) Tag patterns this rule applies to
